newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending Friday's fall.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending Friday's fall.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend Friday's 0.6 percent fall, signalled by stronger selling after price fixing, and analysts said the bourse would likely continue its general flat trend before September's elections.

Analysts said the news over the weekend that the government would seek to amend this year's budget to allow more central bank financing and foreign borrowing could also negatively affect bourse sentiment.
Rafako and ZEW remain suspended after the flooding at their plants in southern Poland last week.

Analysts said copper company KGHM should soon suffer its first profit-taking fall after rising 2.1 percent on Friday and starting trade on Thursday 11.9 percent above its institutional investor issue price.
